title: Stake
subtitle: Earn a share of protocol revenue.

errors.invalid-amount: Enter an ORI amount greater than zero, with at most 6 decimal places
errors.zero-amount: Enter an ORI amount greater than zero, with at most 6 decimal places
errors.account-changed: Wallet account changed. The operation stopped
errors.insufficient-allowance: Allowance is still insufficient. Deposit was not sent
errors.simulation-reverted: Contract preflight reverted. Transaction was not sent
errors.rpc-error: Network request failed. Check wallet/explorer before retrying
errors.confirmation-unknown: Confirmation is unresolved. Check the existing transaction; do not resend
errors.replaced: Transaction replaced or cancelled; Stake action not completed

hints.totalDeposit: The total amount of ORI currently deposited in the protocol.
hints.apr: The estimated annual yield on deposited tokens, denominated in ORI. This estimate is based on historical yields over the past 7 days and does not guarantee future earnings or returns.
hints.tvl: The total estimated value of tokens locked in the protocol.
